hooks.name: Evidence-rules staged diff review
hooks.description: User-triggered: asks the agent to review the staged git diff against the evidence-rules invariants — every claim must have a citation, and the verifier may not change unless a spec task is referenced.

action.prompt:
The user has requested an evidence-rules review of the current staged diff.

1. Run: git diff --cached
2. Read: .kiro/steering/evidence-rules.md
3. Check EVERY changed line in src/ghost/verifier.ts against the invariants listed there — reject any change that weakens a verifier invariant unless the commit message references a spec task ID.
4. For any GhostAnswer or EvidenceItem changes, confirm that all claims still require at least one { sha7, quote? } citation.
5. Output a short checklist: ✅ or ❌ per invariant, with the offending line if failing.
